series.title: Real GDP per capita
series.definition: Output per person using a documented real GDP measure and a compatible population denominator.
series.aggregation: Preserve the source volume methodology and population convention.
series.usage_notes: Candidate only. No verified observations or coverage claims. Dataset-specific usage terms are inherited from the audited source records.

series.title: Population
series.definition: Resident population with the reference date and population concept fixed in the source audit.
series.aggregation: Reference-date level; do not silently substitute annual-average population.
series.usage_notes: Candidate only. No verified observations or coverage claims. Dataset-specific usage terms are inherited from the audited source records.

series.title: Real GDP
series.definition: Output measured in volumes; preserve price basis and reconstruction methodology.
series.aggregation: Preserve official annual volume measure.
series.usage_notes: Candidate only. No verified observations or coverage claims. Dataset-specific usage terms are inherited from the audited source records.

series.title: Real GDP growth
series.definition: Annual change in a verified real GDP series; sports-event adjustments must have distinct series identities.
series.aggregation: Annual change; calculation and source measure pending audit.
series.usage_notes: Candidate only. No verified observations or coverage claims. Dataset-specific usage terms are inherited from the audited source records.

series.title: Registered unemployment
series.definition: Register-based unemployment rate with denominator and methodological changes recorded.
series.aggregation: Native monthly readings; annual means require a separate derived series.
series.usage_notes: Candidate only. No verified observations or coverage claims. Dataset-specific usage terms are inherited from the audited source records.

series.title: ILO unemployment

series.usage_notes: Candidate only. No verified observations or coverage claims. Dataset-specific usage terms are inherited from the audited source records.

series.title: Annual CPI inflation
series.definition: Change between annual-average CPI index levels, once the underlying source is verified.
series.aggregation: 100 × (annual-average CPI / previous annual-average CPI − 1).
series.usage_notes: Candidate only. No verified observations or coverage claims. Dataset-specific usage terms are inherited from the audited source records.
